resources.string: The service stops on its own
To save battery, some phones stop the apps they consider idle, accessibility services included. SeekMind then stops remembering, until you turn it back on.

If the search screen says « Service turned off », tap « Turn back on » and enable SeekMind again in the accessibility settings. To keep it from stopping again, exclude SeekMind from battery optimisation as shown below for your phone.
1. Settings › Apps › SeekMind › Battery: choose « Unrestricted ».\n2. Settings › Battery › Background usage limits: make sure SeekMind is in neither « Sleeping apps » nor « Deep sleeping apps ».
1. Settings › Apps › Manage apps › SeekMind › Battery saver: choose « No restrictions ».\n2. On the same page, turn on « Autostart ».
1. Settings › Apps › App management › SeekMind › Battery usage: allow background activity.\n2. On the same page, allow auto launch.
1. Settings › Battery › App launch › SeekMind: turn off « Manage automatically ».\n2. In the window that opens, keep « Auto-launch », « Secondary launch » and « Run in background » on.
1. Settings › Apps › SeekMind › Battery: allow background activity.\n2. Settings › Battery › Battery optimisation › SeekMind: choose « Don\'t optimise ».
Settings › Apps › SeekMind › Battery: choose « Unrestricted » (or « Not optimised »).
Menu names vary with the version of Android and of the manufacturer\'s interface: look for the closest wording.
